criterion_from_prepared_protocol: P_peak>S_peak and S_final>P_final, with P declining and S increasing
clarification: The original Figure14 also shows self attention larger than previous-token attention at the ICL-related bump. Dominance switch is an additional strict descriptive condition, not necessary for previous-token behavior or the author mechanism. Failure of this condition alone does not refute the paper.
observations: At sampled checkpoints from1M onward, all heads have S>P. Head0 has a previous-token rebound at4.4M relative to3M, but P at20M is slightly above P at4.4M on all four evaluators. Heads1-7 have lower P and higher S at20M than4.4M.
limitations: Only11 checkpoints; no ablation/grafting; cannot establish L1 causal role or L2 computational reuse.
